svg.title: PATCHCORD cluster kill chain - APT36 against Afghan telecom and South Asian critical infrastructure
svg.desc: Two-lane diagram. The left lane follows the victim endpoint: a sector-branded Inno Setup installer impersonating Afghan Telecom, the PATCHCORD C/C++ implant, the critical browser shortcut hijack persistence, registration and the api.jsp tasking loop, the critical in-memory shellcode opcode, the Go successor SHEETCORD with Startup folder persistence, and an anti-analysis variant. The right lane follows the operator: a single command and control server at 46.30.188.13, ten months of rotating lookalike domain fronts, a critical exposed staging directory holding open-source frameworks and exploit tooling, the AI-assisted HACKERAI C2 Agent on GitHub Gists, the critical migration of command and control onto Google Sheets and GitHub, and a moderate-confidence attribution note. Detection anchors are the two registry Run value names, the lnk backup residue, the Beacon slash one point zero point zero user agent, and non-browser processes calling cloud services.
svg.text: PATCHCORD cluster: Afghan telecom lures, three implants, three C2 paths
Vendor: Acronis TRU (Virtusio, Pontiroli, Singha) - Date: 2026-08-13 - Cluster: APT36 / Transparent Tribe (moderate) - Day 109
VICTIM ENDPOINT - what an IR team can observe
OPERATOR INFRASTRUCTURE - passive DNS, certs, open dir
Sector-branded installer executed
Telecom_TMS.zip -> TMS_AfghanTelecom.exe (Inno Setup 6.7.0)
Delphi 12.0, .NET Reactor; publisher metadata = Afghan Telecom
AppPublisherUrl points at the genuine AFTEL request portal
overlay at 0x00136200 -> TMS_Launcher.exe (147 KB)
PATCHCORD implant initialises
64-bit MSVC C/C++; console window hidden immediately
Checks its own Run value first - it doubles as infection marker
Reads Windows ProductName from HKLM CurrentVersion
tms_launcher.exe d46ee94d6a27ff9f02cff6fb57780aca...
HKCU\...\Run\BeaconBrowserHijack = implant path
Browser shortcut hijack (persistence)
Five .lnk locations: taskbar, Quick Launch, Start Menu, desktops
Original copied to <name>.lnk.backup, then target rewritten
Real browser path kept as argument; icon preserved - looks normal
resolved via IShellLinkW + IPersistFile (no re-hijack)
working directory forced to C:\Windows\System32
Registration and tasking loop
JSON: hostname, username, OS version, PID, image path, name
POST to C2 root returns clientId= plus a 36-char UUID
GET /api.jsp?clientId=... on TCP 8080; HTML comment wrapper
InternetOpenW user agent: Beacon/1.0.0 (30 s timeouts)
response "It's Work!" = terminate and exit the loop
Opcode 0x1C - in-memory shellcode
Custom Base64 alphabet decode, then XOR with a session key
VirtualAlloc -> copy -> VirtualProtect -> CreateThread
Never written to disk; Metasploit staged on the same server
0x1D: cmd.exe /c hidden, anon pipe, 60 s hard timeout
0x1E: hook / unhook / status / restore the shortcut hijack
SHEETCORD - the Go successor
Tasking via powershell -Command with script-block wrapping
SystemHelper.vbs dropped into the per-user Startup folder
Six browsers hijacked by generating temp_update.vbs
Run value SystemHelper written by shelling out to reg.exe
system-agent.exe 959bbb09cd86ce3930406bf1cf32776c...
Anti-analysis variant (March 2026)
Device handles: VBoxGuest, VBoxTrayIPC, vmci, HGFS
IsDebuggerPresent plus the PEB BeingDebugged flag
Process list includes sysmon.exe, x64dbg.exe, wireshark.exe
on any hit: randomised sleep 30-90 s, never exits
requires >1 CPU and >=2 GB RAM before running
A
One server behind every front
46.30.188.13 - AS199959, Gwy IT Pty Ltd, Netherlands
Single nginx serving /download across all domain fronts
TCP 8080 tasking, TCP 443 SuperShell panel, TCP 4444 msf
Live and responding at the time of publication
Let's Encrypt certificates rotated three times
each SAN bundle leaked another slice of the domain set
B
Ten months of rotating lookalikes
appstoore.duckdns.org (Dec 2025) - the earliest front
appstoore.solutions (Jan 2026) - hardcoded in PATCHCORD
afghantelecom.site and caprispine.health (May 2026)
afghanistanupdates.site, servicesindia.services (Jun 2026)
nic-support.site (13 Jul 2026) served SHEETCORD
only nicservice.org was retired - the rest stayed up
C
Exposed staging directory
Campaign lures plus four archives never seen on VirusTotal
GateSentinel, Nim-Backdoor, antnium, four Python listeners
HackBrowserData, hydra.restore, rockyou_2025_05.txt
Exploit tooling for regreSSHion and PwnKit
CVE-2024-6387 and CVE-2021-4034 staged, not confirmed used
Routers_backup.zip, Sessions_Backup.zip, iOS call history
D
HACKERAI C2 Agent (AI-assisted)
defence.cgda.site, first observed 8 September 2025
Tasking and exfiltration over GitHub Gists
Hardcoded personal access token left inside the binary
Stalling loop over the strings foo, bar, baz + randomSleep
clear-text debug string: [LOG] Agent Started
double XOR with the same 0xAB key - a no-op
E
C2 moved onto services nobody blocks
SHEETCORD: Google Sheets API v4, one tab per victim
GCP service account credentials embedded in the binary
HACKERAI: GitHub Gist upload and download functions
Detection anchor is the calling process, not the domain
sheets.googleapis.com - allowlisted in most estates
gist.githubusercontent.com - same problem, same fix
F
Attribution - moderate confidence
Targeting: AFTEL, Salaam Telecom, Afghan MCIT, Indian NIC
HackBrowserData reused from earlier APT36 operations
GateSentinel tied to APT36 by Bitdefender, March 2026
Sheets C2 lineage matches the documented SHEETCREEP RAT
SuperShell / SilverFox overlap deliberately NOT used
second SuperShell host: 108.187.42.63 (AS138995)
Detection anchors that outlive the infrastructure
1. Run value names BeaconBrowserHijack and SystemHelper - attacker-chosen, zero legitimate volume, one-line estate sweep.
2. Browser .lnk resolving to a non-browser target, with a .lnk.backup beside it; plus temp_update.vbs and SystemHelper.vbs.
3. Non-browser process in AppData calling sheets.googleapis.com or GitHub Gists on a stable interval - the caller is the signal.
